stem: Three colocated RH sensors read 61%, 62% and 76%. The 76% sensor has no recent verification record. What is the best next action?
choices: Change room RH set point to match 76%
Verify or calibrate the outlier before changing room control
Average all three and ignore the difference
rationale: Colocated agreement between two sensors and missing verification history make the outlier a data-quality concern first.
